title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 improper owner validation allowed reading another workspace's issues and runs…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains Datalore before version 2026.4 allows improper owner validation, which enables unauthorized users with limited privileges to read issues and runs from other workspaces. This flaw does not allow modification or denial of service but exposes some confidential information across workspace boundaries.
